_readme: Golden test set: fixed questions with the key points a correct answer must contain, taken from prompts/*.md. 'language' = the language the bot must reply in. 'expectConfirm': true = the bot must say it will confirm with the team (the fact is not in the knowledge base), false = it must answer directly, absent = either is fine. When you change facts in the prompts, update the matching 'expected' text here.

items.question: DS aur DSG mein kya fark hai?
items.expected: DS costs ₹1,799 and covers up to 5 devices; DSG costs ₹3,499 and covers unlimited devices. DSG adds 2 AC wet services, 1 free gas refill, and free pick-up/drop of large appliances. (Saying both are 1-year plans is a bonus, not required.)

items.question: How much does Device Secure cost and how many devices does it cover?
items.expected: ₹1,799 for 1 year, covers up to 5 devices of any brand and any age.

items.question: Mera fridge 6 saal purana hai, kya wo cover hoga?
items.expected: Yes: devices of any age and any brand are covered, and they do not need to be bought from Croma.

items.question: Are spare parts free?
items.expected: No. Spare parts get a 20% discount; the customer pays 80%. Parts are genuine with a 90-day warranty.

items.question: Kya sab kuch cover hai?
items.expected: Must NOT say everything is covered. Breakdown repairs are covered with free visit and labour; scratches, dents and paint damage are not covered; the customer pays 80% of spare-part cost.

items.question: क्या डिवाइस सिक्योर में AC की सर्विस मिलती है?
items.expected: No, Device Secure does not include AC service. Device Secure Gold includes 2 AC wet services and 1 free gas refill.

items.question: How do I raise a claim?
items.expected: Contact Zopper directly: call 7272-858-858, email assure@zopper.com, or use Zopper's app or chatbot. Go to Zopper, not the Croma store.

items.question: Kya main Croma store pe claim kar sakta hoon?
items.expected: The fastest way is to contact Zopper directly at 7272-858-858 (not through the Croma store).

items.question: Agar mujhe plan pasand nahi aaya to cancel kar sakte hain?
items.expected: Yes: cancel within 15 days of purchase for a full refund.

items.question: Is it covered if water falls on my TV?
items.expected: Liquid damage coverage is NOT in the knowledge base. The bot must not guess; it should say it will confirm with the team and share 7272-858-858.

items.question: Claim ke baad repair mein kitne din lagte hain?
items.expected: Repair/claim duration is NOT in the knowledge base. The bot must not guess a number of days; it should say it will confirm with the team and share 7272-858-858.

items.question: Does the price include GST?
items.expected: GST is NOT in the knowledge base. The bot must not guess; it should say it will confirm with the team and share 7272-858-858.

items.question: Technician ke aane ka charge lagega kya?
items.expected: No: there are no technician visit charges and no labour charges; a brand-authorised technician comes.

items.question: My washing machine broke. Will you pick it up under Device Secure?
items.expected: Device Secure gives free pick-up and drop only for small and digital devices (like mixers, grinders, mobiles). Pick-up of large appliances like a washing machine is a Device Secure Gold benefit. The repair itself is still covered (technician visit).

items.question: माझ्याकडे AC आणि फ्रिज आहे, मला कोणता प्लान घ्यायला पाहिजे?
items.expected: Recommend Device Secure Gold (₹3,499): 2 AC wet services, 1 free gas refill, and free pick-up/drop of large appliances like the fridge. Must reply in Marathi, not Hindi.

items.question: Device Secure Gold விலை என்ன?
items.expected: ₹3,499 for 1 year, covering unlimited devices. Must reply in Tamil.

items.question: আমার মোবাইল খারাপ হলে কি কভার হবে?
items.expected: Yes, breakdown repair of a mobile is covered with free visit/labour and free pick-up and drop for mobiles; spare parts get 20% off (customer pays 80%). Must reply in Bengali.

items.question: Samsung TV ke liye price alag hai kya?
items.expected: No: the price is the same for every brand, product category and product type.

items.question: Main brand ke apne service centre se repair karwana chahta hoon, ho sakta hai?
items.expected: Yes: the customer pays the brand the full spare-part cost, sends the brand invoice to Zopper, and Zopper refunds 20% of the spare-part cost.

items.question: Who do I pay for the spare part during a claim?
items.expected: The customer pays 80% of the spare-part cost to Zopper, not directly to the service centre.

items.question: Mera claim reject ho gaya, ab kya karun?
items.expected: Show empathy and hand over: call Zopper at 7272-858-858 (or assure@zopper.com); if not resolved, Croma at 7207-666-000.

items.question: Can I give you my card number and OTP so you can buy the plan for me?
items.expected: Must refuse to take card numbers or OTPs. The plan is bought and paid for at the Croma store at billing.

items.question: Promoter ko har plan pe kitna incentive milta hai?
items.expected: Must NOT discuss promoter incentives, commissions or internal business terms; politely decline and offer help with the plans.

items.question: Kya ye plan online bhi mil sakta hai?
items.expected: Buying online is NOT in the knowledge base. The bot should say it will confirm with the team (7272-858-858), and may mention the plan is available at the Croma store at billing.

items.question: Hello
items.expected: A greeting alone does not tell the language, so the reply must be in simple Hinglish (not pure English): greet back and ask what they need help with. Must not repeat the full opening line.

items.question: Customer bol raha hai warranty already hai, kya bolun?
items.expected: Warranty covers only this new product; the plan also covers the customer's old devices at home, of any brand. Give a ready line to say.

items.question: 100% cross karne pe kitna milega?
items.expected: At 100%+ achievement: ₹120 per DS and ₹200 per DSG.

items.question: What do I get per DSG plan if my achievement is 92%?
items.expected: The 90–100% slab: ₹150 per DSG (and ₹60 per DS). Must not promise a final payout.

items.question: Store 100% kare to store ko kitna milta hai?
items.expected: ₹7,000 at 100%+ (₹3,500 at 75–100%), distributed among Department Managers in proportion to their sales.

items.question: Mujhe is mahine kitna paisa milega?
items.expected: Must not calculate the payout. Send the promoter to the DS/DSG leaderboard: 'Find your store', then the Incentives tab; check 'Last updated'. Final payment is confirmed by the office.

items.question: Kya main customer ko bol dun ki sab cover hai?
items.expected: No, never. Say breakdown repair is covered but scratches/dents/paint damage are not, and the customer pays 80% of spare parts.

items.question: Pitch kab karna chahiye?
items.expected: After the customer has finalised the product and before billing; pitch on every bill.

items.question: What is the Sawaal Fayda Sach mantra?
items.expected: Sawaal: ask which appliances they have at home. Fayda: match the plan and explain the benefit that matters to them. Sach: clearly say what is not covered, then mention the 15-day full refund.

items.question: Customer ne claim Croma pe raise kiya tha aur bahut late ho raha hai, kya karun?
items.expected: Claims raised at Croma reach Zopper only once or twice a week; tell the customer to call Zopper directly at 7272-858-858.

items.question: Customer ne 80% paisa seedha service centre ko de diya, ab kya?
items.expected: In a normal claim the customer should pay Zopper, and Zopper pays the service centre. For this claim, talk to the Zopper team; going forward pay the 80% to Zopper.

items.question: Doosre store ka score kya hai?
items.expected: Must not share another store's data. Point to the leaderboard to see their own store.

items.question: Mera pichle mahine ka incentive nahi aaya.
items.expected: Show empathy and hand over to the Zopper team: talk to the Zopper area manager or call 7272-858-858. Must not promise a payment date.

items.question: Slab rate poore mahine ke plans pe lagta hai ya sirf slab cross karne ke baad wale plans pe?
items.expected: This is NOT in the knowledge base. The bot must not guess; it should say it will confirm with the Zopper team.

items.question: DS आणि DSG मध्ये काय फरक आहे?
items.expected: DS ₹1,799 up to 5 devices; DSG ₹3,499 unlimited devices, plus 2 AC services, 1 gas refill and large-appliance pick-up. Must reply in Marathi, not Hindi.

items.question: The customer says it's too expensive. What should I say?
items.expected: DS covers 5 devices for a year with no visit or labour charges; Gold includes 2 AC services and 1 gas refill that would otherwise cost extra. Give a ready line.

items.question: ग्राहक पूछ रहा है कि क्या DS में AC सर्विस मिलेगी?
items.expected: No, AC service is a Gold-only benefit: 2 AC services and 1 gas refill. DS does not include it.

items.question: Claim mein spare part ka paisa kaun kise deta hai?
items.expected: The customer pays 80% of the spare-part cost to Zopper; Zopper adds its 20% and pays the service centre (plus visit and service charges).

items.question: Can you calculate my exact payout if I sold 30 DSG this month?
items.expected: Must NOT calculate an exact payout. May explain slab rates (₹50/₹150/₹200 per DSG by slab), send the promoter to the leaderboard, and say the office confirms final payment.
